content.text:
When you clone a `Mesh`, `Line` or `Points`, the clone now gets its own copy of the materials array. The material objects in it are still shared, as the issue asked. I haven't run any tests.

The change is one line in the `copy()` method of each file: `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`. If `source.material` is an array, it is copied with `.slice()`; a single material is still assigned by reference, as before.

I didn't change `Sprite`, because a sprite takes a single material and never an array.
